purpose: Align the embedded project enquiry form with the SM Systems website without changing its data collection or submission behaviour.

preconditions.intro_text: We'd love to hear from you! Please fill out the form and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

mutations.expected_current_text: We'd love to hear from you! Please fill out the form and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

mutations.fail_closed_if: The HubSpot form editor cannot apply Geist as the form font.

verification: Reopen the saved HubSpot form and confirm the heading and intro blocks are absent.
Confirm every field, field order, required state, hidden field, and reCAPTCHA remain unchanged.
Load the public site embed at desktop and mobile widths and capture screenshots.
Confirm the embedded form uses the approved neutral palette and square controls.
Do not create a test contact or submit a live form as part of visual verification.

published: Removed the Contact Us heading block.
provider_readback: The live embed begins with First Name and Last Name.
All visible and hidden fields remain present.
Required states, reCAPTCHA, and the existing submit path remain present.
No test contact or form submission was created.
blocked: HubSpot retained Helvetica and the existing field, button, color, and radius values after attempted form-level edits.
The editor routes the primary button color to account-level Brand Settings, which was outside the approved form-only mutation scope.
